notes.title: Ariel v0.8.9 release
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27082403/aaf85c8f6426f9fd5db5a13e762b3a058c3200bb.png[/img]

Hello everybody,

It's been months since the last update, however we've been working slowly but steady on the project. First of all, with this update we are fixing some of the mechanics which were broken due to our last update. The game is now stable and all mechanics are functioning properly. In addition, we implemented the Mechanical Turret and several small fixes. This is so far the best version of the game we have updated.

Below there is a list of the fixes for this update:
-   Transceivers, Emitters and Central Antenna are all functioning properly now.
-   The Orbiter panel is fixed.
-   Small changes in textures and assets.

We are close to reaching the BETA version, which will include the multiple-endings feature.

There is something we want to let you know about the MacOS version of the game. The engine's version in which the project is being build has not released a patch to make it run on MacOS Catalina. We are waiting until this is solved in order for our game to run in Catalina. It is our understanding that the game runs in earlier versions, but as soon as a fix is released for this issue, we will update the project and let you know.

We hope you get to enjoy Ariel's full experience with these new features. The project is finally coming together. Thanks for your interest and please let us know if you have any questions or comments.

//The Nuclear Fiction Team

notes.title: Ariel v0.8.8 release
notes.content:
Hola everyone,

A new update is out!

We've been working on several new features, some of which are being released in this update.

Below you'll find a checklist of the implemented features and the ones to come:

- Workbench: You can now upgrade your weapons.
- Jetpack: This feature is now available! Upgrade your space suit within the workbench.
- General bug fixing and tweaks.

For the upcoming update, we will be working on the following features:

- Defensive Turret: Protect the camp from enemy hordes.
- A new mechanic will be added to the Main Central computer in Ceres encampment.

We're getting close to enter the Beta stage of development. We will release a new update in the following weeks. We appreciate the interest the community has shown. In the meantime, enjoy this update and let us know if you have any comments or questions. 

//The Nuclear Fiction Team

P.S. Happy Holidays!

notes.title: Ariel v0.8.7 release
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27082403/b7fafa33407bef81aa6465cb1c29a7f785fdfebc.jpg[/img]

Hola,

A mysterious update has arrived! Ariel v0.8.7 is now available.

This update includes a new scene, [b]The Portal[/b], as well as bug fixing and lightning improvement. This sort of "Easter egg" will contribute to the narrative of the game. A dark atmosphere unfolds before you and brings tension to the story-line as professor Ludec finds yet another test to endure.

We took some time in order to implement this new mysterious features, so that Ariel is finally taking form. It will be polished further in upcoming updates. 

For now, here is a list of the fixes we will be working on:

-  Improving camera movement.
-  Portal scene bug fixing.
-  Adding new achievements.
-  Additional dialogues.

After the upcoming update, we will focus on releasing the 0.8.8 version, which will bring new features to the game.

We hope you're having a great weekend and enjoy this release.

//The Nuclear Fiction Team

P.S. Happy Father's Day!

notes.title: New Update coming soon.

notes.title: Ariel v0.8.6 release
notes.content:
Hi everybody,

The new update is here! With this, the 0.8.6 release, Ariel is [b]fully optimized[/b] and the system is stable. This month we worked on the following:

- Third Person mode fully implemented
- Third Person sound effects added
- Elevator inside bunker (Rotation fixed)
- Guidance system tuned
- Several bug fixes

We are reaching a state in the project where we feel comfortable with the features and mechanics developed so far. Moreover, the game is quite stable now on PC, and it will only get better.

For the next update, we'll work in the following:

[b]- The Portal:[/b] This new scene will contribute to the narrative of the game. A dark atmosphere unfolds before you and brings tension to the story-line as professor Ludec finds yet another test to endure.

Thank you for your support, as always, this project would be nothing without you, the players.

//The Nuclear Fiction Team

P.S. Happy New Year!!!

notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27082403/53f00b1a752af5f52e32848d82862af382369ba6.png[/img]

Hello everyone,

First of all, we wanted to thank you for your patience. Finally, the 0.8.5 version of Ariel is here! This update took way more time than expected, but it was all worth it, for key features were implemented and we wanted to make sure this update was stable.

Here are the implementations for this version:

- 3rd Person Mode.
- Guidance system (Map).
- Mood states.
- Several bug fixes.

Below are the changes for the upcoming update:

- 3rd Person mode tuning and fixes.
- Guidance system tuning.
- Footstep Sound FX in 3rd person.
- Overall fixing and improvements.

This release is a big one because the features implemented required hard work. However, we couldn't invest our full time working on this update, due to financial reasons.

We will keep doing our best to deliver a great experience to the community, so please give us your feedback and feel free to contact us with any inquires.

P.S. Happy Mexican Independence Day!

//The Nuclear Fiction Team

notes.title: Ariel v0.8.4 release
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

We hope you are having a great weekend. The 0.8.4 version is finally here!

This update is an important one, for it fixes bugs we detected some time ago, as well as adding new implementations. Here is a list of the changes made for this version:

- 2 new weapons added.
- New suspense elements!
- Better performance and terrain generation: The procedural creation of the terrain is now more precise and the enemies travel through in a more coherent manner.
- Gamepad sensitivity.
- Illumination tweaking. 
- Bug fixes.

The 0.8.5 version will be here soon, and it will mark the end of our first phase of updates. It will include the 3rd person mode, a map (guiding system or similar) and new features!

As usual, we would like to thank you for your support. We are polishing the game and it is certainly gaining momentum. Stay tuned for the the next update! 

/Nuclear Fiction Team

-  Many bug fixes.

These improvements create a more solid experience overall. 

Now, for the following updates we expect to be working on these:

- More elements of suspense.
- Additional weapons and upgrades.
- 3rd Person mode.

We are happy with the outcome. However, we are aware of all the things that are yet to come. We appreciate your patience and support.

/Nuclear Fiction Team

notes.title: Ariel v0.8.1 release - Optimized Build.
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27082403/2a6409f68893fef0efd39d1320968923602a20dd.png[/img]

Hello everyone,

The 0.8.1 version is finally here! We are quite happy with the results, and hope you enjoy the game more than ever. With each update the game is improved to reach the expectations.

First, we will point out the work done for this version:

- Optimization: We took our time making sure the game runs much better than the previous version. In average, we gain 15 frames per second (*see below) We also resolved a known issue where the frames dropped every three or four seconds. The game runs now smoothly and is optimized.

- Item balancing: We finally took the opportunity to tweak further the items given in the world. It is now well proportioned according to the difficulty chosen by the player

- New weapon added: A second weapon is now available. We will eventually add at least 2 new weapons in future updates. For now, the Plasma Gun and the Electro-magnetic Pulse Rifle are available in game.

- Enemy behavior: The current creatures living in Ariel needed a better behavior.

- Extras: We added a few tweaks here and there. We also fixed a couple of bugs and improved some mechanics.


We feel that the version released today should have been the actual release on Early Access. At the same time, it was useful for us to get the game out a bit earlier in order to detect important areas to work on first.

Since we are a only two active developers, it has been a lot of work, but all worth it, since we believe that the project is finally reaching a satisfactory experience. It will be getting better and better, but we can certainly recommend this version to any player who might be intrigued by the project.

As usual, thank you for your support. Let us know if you have any comments. We hope you like this new update!

The Nuclear Fiction team.


*GTX 970
Core i5
16 GB Ram

Older version:
17-40 frames per second with frame drop.

Current Version:
35-50 frames per second, without any frame drop.

notes.title: Weekly Update #4
notes.content:
Hola!

We had a week full of things to do. Here are the changes for Week 4:

- Field of view fully implemented.
- Depth of field added
- Fixes: Pressurizing while battery runs out of energy. Ending: incoming call while sleeping. Typos and general fixes. Key Item count and days survived texts are now displayed when dying, as well as in the end of the game.

Some of the upcoming changes are written below:

- Enemies: Overall behaviour of the enemies. HP tuning. More logical paths and spawn points. Velocity of bunker enemies and fixes.
- We will be adding a new weapon!
- Ammo - Reload clip, ammo packs for the new weapons.
- Flashlight tuning.

Our road to follow: 

We'll keep fixing bugs and errors, as well as refining some mechanics. 
We will soon add the second part of the controller implementation (We saw that most of the gamepad issues have been fixed with the first part of the implementation) 
We will work towards the enemy overall behaviour. 
In addition, we will implement a jetpack! 
After balancing the resources according to the level of difficulty, we will board the optimization and loading times. Just as a reminder, the 0.8.1 version will be the one with the optimization process fully stablished.

We feel that we are advancing at a good pace. We will keep up working towards an optimized and stable version which will be ready, hopefully, in a couple of weeks.

As always, let us remind you how much we appreciate your feedback and enthusiasm towards the project. Have a great weekend!

/Nuclear Fiction Team

notes.title: Weekly Update #2
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

During the second week we achieved important improvements to the general stability of the game. Though there are still many things to accomplish, we feel that the project is going through the right path. We wanted to share with you the changes made during this week, as well as the upcoming changes for week 3:

[b]Ariel Verion 0.8.0.5[/b]
[list]
[*]We eliminated various debug keys that needed to be removed.
[*]We tweaked some values for the decreasing stats.
[*]We finally set a stable version concerning the food processor, the batteries, the liquid processor and other panels, such as the repair panel.
[*]Atmospherical conditions are now more coherent.
[*]While reading documents, the main stats do not decrease. 
[*]Gustave Atkinson is now searchable.
[*]The player now falls normally to the ground when dying.
[*]Many bug fixes and general improvement. 
[/list]

For the upcoming week, we plan the following changes:
[list]
[*]A more stable setup for gamepads: We are working towards a setup in which the software recognizes the input accordingly. Also, the default setup for Ariel will be the keyboard and mouse; We noticed that many people played with gamepad because it was set as the default input if the gamepad was plugged in.
[*]Field Of View (FOV) slider will be available.
[*]Depth Of Field (DOF) option will be available.
[/list]

Asides from this, we wanted to let you know that Ariel is still in a very early phase of development. We are working towards a version that will fit better the overall ideas that we've been listening from you. Once we achieve this, probably in two weeks, we will dive fully into the optimization and loading times. We are aware of the typos that people have mentioned to us, and we will correct them in the following updates. We wanted to thank everyone who has been patient. We can assure you that we are working towards a more desired gameplay. We will deliver a better product with each passing week. Thank you again for your interest.

PS: We developed the whole project with a GTX970. We recently found this video and we wanted to share it with you since it runs pretty much the same as in our specs.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Oli2qg49_A4

notes.title: Important Update!
notes.content:
Hi, everyone.

Today we accomplished a big fix. Over the weekend, we detected a few issues, as well as a major bug. We managed to reach a very stable version and we wanted to share this with you. 

There was a debug key ("B") that automatically changed scenes. This was a terrible mistake that had to be corrected. In this version (0.8.0.3), this error no longer exists. Also, the gamepad input in the repair interface is fixed now.

Asides from that, we tuned the decrease rate of the main stats and improved a few other things. The flashlight is now more coherent, and some items are easier to see around. We also added the mouse wheel and the run key to the input display.

We'll keep working towards an even more stable version during the week. As usual, let us know if you have any comments or suggestions; your gameplay videos have been very useful to us, thanks!

/The Nuclear Fiction Team.

notes.title: Important Update!
notes.content:
Hi, everyone.

Today we accomplished a big fix. Over the weekend, we detected a few issues, as well as a major bug. We managed to reach a very stable version and we wanted to share this with you. 

There was a debug key ("B") that automatically changed scenes. This was a terrible mistake that had to be corrected. In this version (0.8.0.3), this error no longer exists. Also, the gamepad input in the repair interface is fixed now.

Asides from that, we tuned the decrease rate of the main stats and improved a few other things. The flashlight is now more coherent, and some items are easier to see around. We also added the mouse wheel and the run key to the input display.

We'll keep working towards an even more stable version during the week. As usual, let us know if you have any comments or suggestions; your gameplay videos have been very useful to us, thanks!

/The Nuclear Fiction Team.

notes.title: Weekly Update #1
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27082403/e63cc617ddcc82ac671521521115833f117b16ab.png[/img]

Hi all,

Thank you for being kind to our particular release on Early Access. There were still a few very important things unaccomplished and we implemented them over the week. 

We wanted to keep you posted on the improvements and suggestions during this week. Below is a list of the implementations:

- There was a particular case in which the 3rd Person mode could be activated. We fixed this small issue, allowing only the 1st Person mode for now.

- Main stats stop decreasing while reading a computer log.

- Events can be prevented now by changing only one Tesla tower's frequency. (In tough events, two frequencies are required.) 

- Your starting Hydration stat is higher.

- Interlude texts are easier to read.

- A more solid configuration of Weather Events.

- A little tweak on the resources balance. 

- Bug fixes: Food Processors, C3 & C4 batteries, Pressurized stations.

We detected a major bug while repairing a computer. We fixed all of the possible cases, but we're still hunting problems with it. 

Though the game is very difficult, it is possible for it to be completed. We will keep reading all your comments and feedback in order to reach a more balanced overall gameplay.

Thank you. Have a great weekend.

/The Nuclear Fiction Team
